Деклариране на основанията за отстраняване в ЕЕДОП и правила за подписване на ЕЕДОП При подаване на офертата участникът декларира липсата на основанията за отстраняване в Единен европейски документ за обществени поръчки в електронен вид (еЕЕДОП), като попълва разделите на Част III „Основания за изключване“. На основание чл. 67, ал. 5 от ЗОП възложителят може да изиска от участниците по всяко време да представят всички или част от посочените в чл. 58, ал. 1 от ЗОП документи, когато това е необходимо за законосъобразното провеждане на процедурата. Липсата на обстоятелства, свързани с националните основания за отстраняване, се декларира в ЕЕДОП в Част ІІІ, раздел Г: „Други основания за изключване, които може да бъдат предвидени в националното законодателство на възлагащия орган или възложителя на държава членка“ на ЕЕДОП в полето „Прилагат ли се специфичните национални основания за изключване“. Отговор „не“ се отнася за всички обстоятелства. При отговор „да“ лицето трябва да посочи конкретното обстоятелство, както и евентуално предприетите мерки за надеждност. description:
EnVision is a Venus orbiter mission selected by ESA’s Science Programme Committee as the fifth Medium-class mission in the Agency’s Cosmic Vision plan. It will be the first mission to investigate Venus from its inner core to its upper atmosphere, characterising the interaction between its atmosphere, surface/subsurface and interior. It aims at providing a holistic view of Venus, studying the planet’s history, activity, and climate. An overview of the EnVision mission and its objectives can be found on the Agency website here: https://www.esa.int/Science_Exploration/Space_Science/EnVision_factsheet.

TAS-I will release an Invitation To Tender for the procurement of the Independent Software Verification and Validation (ISVV).
Independent Software Verification and Validation (ISVV) is an engineering practice intended to improve quality and to reduce development risks of the On-board Software.
The main objective of ISVV activities is to find issues that would really provoke a mission loss, severe mission degradation or major non-compliance to requirements.

This objective will be reached by performing the following main tasks:
•	independently verify the SW components subject of this ISVV contract
•	independently analyze the specifications, the design and justification documents, the source code and test results
•	identifying critical areas
•	proposing validation tests and stress testing on the identified critical areas

title: DEVELOPMENT OF IN-SITU REAL-TIME SENSOR FOR MOLECULAR CONTAMINATION MONITORING OF FLIGHT HARDWARE - EXPRO PLUS
description: The number of future missions with higher and higher cleanliness requirements is constantlyincreasing (e.g. LISA, AEOLUS-2). Current monitoring methods for molecular contamination do onlyallow a limited representativeness with regards to the actual levels deposited on sensitive surfaces.Indeed, molecular contamination witnesses can almost never be placed close enough to the sensitive surfaces (for accessibility precautionary reasons) and cannot provide constant monitoring due to the incompatibility with some of the testing environments. Besides, measurements are performed periodically in laboratory environment and only provide punctual values, typically on monthly basis. For all these reasons, contamination measurements can only be taken as estimateand hypotheses are needed inorder to evaluate the levels on sensitive surfaces. This situationbecomes critical for highly sensitive items and clearly the morestringent are the requirements, thehigher risks are undertaken.Having the capability to perform in-situ real-time monitoring of the molecular contaminationdeposited on sensitive surfaces will allow to determine the actual contamination levels and to identify which phases are the most critical. Such a technology will contribute to ensure that the instrument performance will be met and will provide the capability to quickly implement mitigation actions if contamination levels increase unexpectedly. In addition, the use of this technology can be extended in flight. Operation in-flight will allow the optimization of the commissioning anddecontamination phases, thus ensuring optimal performances while maximizing instrumentavailability during the mission.Currently, two technologies are considered for the development of such a sensor, either based onOptical Micro-Electro-Mechanical-System or on micro-wave transduction.This activity encompasses the following tasks:- Design definition considering the operational constraints- Manufacturingof breadboard to experimentally assess the suitability of the selected technology and its robustness against typical environment- Definition of a test plan and implementation of the associated test campaign laboratoryenvironment to determine the evaluated system performance- Identification of the required steps to manufacture a qualification unit for in-flight operationProcurement Policy: C(1) = Activity restricted to non-prime contractors (incl. description: Turun kaupungilla on laajasti käytössä Trimble Solutions Oy:n paikkatietojärjestelmä. Järjestelmällä hallitaan Turun kaupungin rakennetun ympäristön tietoja. Järjestelmä tarjoaa työkalut Turun kaupungin erilaisten lupaprosessien sähköiseen lupakäsittelyyn, rakennustyönaikaiseen sähköiseen valvontaan sekä rakennus- ja kiinteistörekisterin ylläpitoon. Turun kaupungin lupaprosesseista Trimble Locus Cloudin tietojärjestelmässä käsitellään rakennusvalvonnan myöntämät luvat lupahakemuksesta työnaikaiseen valvontaan ja loppukatselmukseen, yleisten alueiden luvat, ympäristönsuojelun hallinnoima ympäristövalvonta sekä kiinteistötoimitukset. Hankinnan tarkoituksena on kehittää kaupungin käytössä olevia Trimble Locus Cloud ja asiointi.fi -lupapalvelusovelluksia. Tavoitteena on parantaa asiointi.fi -lupapalveluiden loppukäyttäjien käyttökokemusta. Kehitystyö tehdään yhdessä 9 muun kaupungin kanssa. Jokainen kaupunki tekee oman hankintapäätöksen ja oman sopimuksen asiassa Trimble Solutions Oy:n kanssa. Kehitystyö kohdistuu järjestelmään, johon vain Trimble Solutions Oy:llä on oikeudet. Sovelluksien kehittämistyö toteutetaan hyödyntämällä nykyistä ratkaisua. Trimble Solutions Oy:llä on yksinoikeus toteuttamansa paikkatietojärjestelmän ratkaisuihin, teknologiaan ja lähdekoodiin. Kehitystyö edellyttää paikkatietojärjestelmän ratkaisun ja lähdekoodin muokkaamista. Kehitystyö toteuttaminen muun toimijan toimesta ei ole teknisesti mahdollista eikä myöskään Trimble Solutions Oy:n järjestelmän teknisten ratkaisujen suojaamiseen liittyvistä syistä. Trimble Solutions Oy on lisensoinut tuotteensa, eikä työtä voi tehdä myöskään mikään muu toimittaja ko. yksinoikeudesta johtuen. Kehitystyötä ei myöskään ole mahdollistettu kolmannen osapuolen kanssa Turun kaupungin ja Trimble Solutions Oy:n välisen sopimuksen mukaan. Ottaen huomioon edellä mainittu ei hankintayksiköllä ole mahdollista hyödyntää järkeviä vaihtoehtoisia tai korvaavia ratkaisuja. title: Mass Spectrometer (Exploris 480)
description: DTU Bioengineering is looking to acquire a new mass spectrometer and two LC systems to expand their capacity for proteomic samples in the field of spatial proteomics all the way down to single-cell level. The instruments will be used for running large-scale spatial proteomics experiments and will be incorporated into the DTU Proteomics Core. The DTU Proteomics Core at DTU Bioengineering houses five Orbitrap mass spectrometers. With the ambition of expanding in the field of spatial proteomics, the facility has a need to increase their current instrument capacity. Currently the most used instrument is the Orbitrap Exploris 480 instrument, which can’t keep up with the increasing demands. It is therefore vital that the DTU Proteomics Core obtains a duplicate setup, to expand their resources to two Orbitrap Exploris 480s and two matching LC systems. The duplicate setup is specifically needed as expansion into the field of spatial proteomics will result in larger sample sets. This will block the instrument for other smaller projects for weeks to months. The duplicate setup will therefore provide capacity and flexibility of the exact same analysis on either of the two instruments. The DTU Proteomics Core needs the mass spectrometer to fulfil all the following criteria: - Robust instrumentation - Resolving power in the low m/z range required for running multiplexed analysis with TMT-labelling with 18-plex and 35-plex methods - High resolution settings of 120,000 and 240,000 for single-cell analysis - Orthogonal separation for low-input samples and samples with matrix interference DTU Bioengineering is looking to acquire a new mass spectrometer and two LC systems to expand their capacity for proteomic samples in the field of spatial proteomics all the way down to single-cell level.
